content: Deleted in Bladder Cancer Protein 1 (DBC1) is a protein in humans encoded by the DBC1 gene. This gene is located on chromosome 9, specifically in the 9q32-33 region. This chromosomal region is notable for frequently exhibiting loss of heterozygosity in transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder. The DBC1 gene contains a 5' CpG island, which is a region of DNA that may be a common target for hypermethylation. In some cases of bladder cancer, this hypermethylation can lead to the silencing of the gene. The precise biological functions of the DBC1 gene remain unknown. It has not yet been classified into any specific protein family or functional pathway. However, it is hypothesized to function as a tumor suppressor gene.
